title: link-oscore-fork.sh: HOME-unset guard + document in-repo invocation only
description: P3 findings from xyt6.1 pass-3 review: (1) set -u aborts with HOME: unbound variable in minimal environments before the candidate-list diagnostics - guard with HOME:- fallback; (2) invocation through a symlinked copy of the script resolves rust_dir to the symlink's parent and creates the link in the wrong place - document invoke-by-in-repo-path in the header (portable symlink resolution is awkward without readlink -f on macOS).
close_reason: Fixed: (1) HOME:- fallback in candidates array so set -u environments get the candidate-list error instead of an unbound-variable abort (verified with env -u HOME: clean error, exit 1); (2) header documents invoke-by-in-repo-path limitation. Verified in sandbox: all 7 behavior paths (fresh link, idempotent rerun, foreign valid symlink honored, dangling repointed, wrong-target repointed, real-dir honored/rejected, no-candidates error).
